summary: Medications Management Feature - Backend API testing completed successfully. All 23 tests passed (100%). CRUD operations, daily-plan, check-in toggle, and adherence stats all work correctly.

minor.issue: Aggressive rate limiting (429) - affects cleanup but not core functionality

frontend_issues.note: Frontend testing skipped per request - this is a React Native Expo app that cannot be tested via browser

endpoints_tested: GET /api/medications/{profile_id} - List all medications (returns correct structure with medications array)
POST /api/medications/{profile_id} - Create medication with all fields (name, dosage, unit, timings, frequency, specific_days, meal_relation, note)
PUT /api/medications/{profile_id}/{med_id} - Update medication fields (partial update works)
PUT /api/medications/{profile_id}/{med_id} with empty body - Returns 400 correctly
DELETE /api/medications/{profile_id}/{med_id} - Deletes medication and associated logs
GET /api/medications/{profile_id}/daily-plan - Returns combined daily plan (supplements + medications)
POST /api/medications/{profile_id}/{med_id}/check-in - Toggle medication check-in (first call=checked, second call=unchecked)

verified_features.crud: Create/Read/Update/Delete all work correctly with proper validation
verified_features.specific_days_filtering: Medications with frequency='specific_days' only appear on those days (tested on Sunday - Mo/Mi/Fr medication correctly excluded)
verified_features.meal_relation_labels: German: 'Nach dem Essen', Italian: 'Dopo il pasto'

critical_code_review_comments: medications.py: Well-structured code with proper Pydantic models and validation
daily-plan endpoint correctly combines supplements and medications from different collections
Check-in toggle logic works correctly (deletes existing log on second call)
specific_days filtering uses German weekday abbreviations (Mo, Di, Mi, Do, Fr, Sa, So)
All MongoDB queries use projection={'_id': 0} to exclude ObjectId correctly
Proper HTTP error codes: 400 for empty update, 404 for not found
seed_data_creation: Test medications created during testing (TEST_Aspirin, TEST_VitaminD_Weekly) - cleanup attempted but rate limited. Existing Metformin medication preserved.
